pages.text: Julia is six. She is in her backyard, playing on her scooter.
pages.picture: a six-year-old girl riding a scooter in a sunny backyard

pages.text: Then she hears a yelp. "Yelp! Yelp!" It is from the wood.
pages.picture: the girl stopping, listening, woods beyond the garden

pages.text: Julia hops up on the gate and jumps down. Then she runs to the wood.
pages.picture: girl climbing over a garden gate and running toward trees

pages.text: Under a tree sits a dragon. He is white, and his scales shine pink and green and blue.
pages.picture: a small white dragon whose scales shimmer with rainbow sparkles, sitting under a tree

pages.text: The dragon looks up. A big tear drips down his nose.
pages.picture: close-up of the sad white dragon with a tear

pages.text: "I am Toby," he said. "I ran away from home."
pages.picture: the dragon introducing himself shyly to the girl

pages.text: "Is your home far?" asked Julia. "It is a cave on top of Super-Tall Peak," said Toby.
pages.picture: a very tall pointy mountain far away with a cave near the top

pages.text: "But what made you run away?" asked Julia. Toby looks down at his feet. He will not say.
pages.picture: the dragon looking away, keeping a secret, the girl curious

pages.text: Julia pats his nose. "You can stay with me," she said. "I have a play house!"
pages.picture: the girl gently patting the dragon's nose

pages.text: Toby squeezes into the play house. He just fits. "Hush!" said Julia. "Mum must not see you."
pages.picture: the dragon squeezed inside the little playhouse, the girl with a finger to her lips
